question: Find Head and Neck trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

llama.answer: This query will return Head and Neck trials with median follow-up and show months by arm.
llama.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\" AS \"Experimental Arm\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\" AS \"Control Arm\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Head and Neck%' AND \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\" IS NOT NULL AND \"follow_up_duration_control_months\" IS NOT NULL",

}
```
